lines.2: 「That's how I'm thinking of approaching her today.」
lines.3: 「Well, we won't know till you try it.」
lines.6: 「D-Don't tell me this has turned into a steamy four-way battle over me?!」
lines.8: 「Even if it did, I'd gladly withdraw.」
lines.9: 「Me too! Friendship before women, that's my motto!」
lines.10: 「You guys sure are loyal to each other...」
lines.11: 「We're figuring out how to persuade Nagomi Yashi.」
lines.12: 「My, what a surprise. I thought yesterday's total defeat would've taught you a lesson.」
lines.13: 「Hey, it's much too early to give up.」
lines.14: 「In baseball terms, we're only in the top of the fourth. Anything can happen before the ninth.」
lines.15: 「The mercy rule kicks in after the fifth. Watch yourself.」
lines.16: 「Tch. You don't have a cute bone in your body.」
lines.17: 「What kind of plan are you going with?」
lines.18: 「I'll lure her with food. Tame her with treats.」
lines.19: 「Women can be suckers for this sort of thing.」
lines.20: 「That sounds just a tiny bit like sexual harassment, doesn't it, Yoshimi?」
lines.21: 「I-I don't think it goes quite that far.」
lines.22: 「Look, isn't the kitty in this picture adorable?」
lines.23: 「Ooh, it really is! I wanna pet it!」
lines.25: 「Yoppi, are you more of a dog person or a cat person?」
lines.27: 「'Yoppi and a dog' has such a naughty ring to it.」
lines.28: 「I don't even know what you find naughty about that anymore, but you're harassing me much more than Leo is, Ellie.」
